snippet.title: Astro Burn | Demo Trailer [GOG]
snippet.description:
GOG Preservation Program! 
https://www.youtube.com/@gogclassicsvault
Follow us on:
Web: 👉  https://bit.ly/3rpVmMh
Twitch: 👉  https://bit.ly/3vVI6CJ
Twitter: 👉  https://bit.ly/3fdOUFK
Facebook: 👉  https://bit.ly/2NWKVCw

Astro Burn isn’t just a mindless bullet-hell cute-’em-up — there’s real heart at its core. Between each level, a story unfolds as we follow Astro on her own “follow the yellow brick road” journey to find her way back home with her robot sidekick.

But what if the chaos we’re battling through isn’t just external? What if every level is a manifestation of Astro’s feline subconscious — a dream… or perhaps a nightmare?

KEY FEATURES

nostalgic side-scrolling Cute -’em-up inspired by 16-bit classics

Reborn with slick modern pixel art, tight controls, and adrenaline-pumping action.

9 lives cat health system

2 Player Co-Op Arcade modes 

Unlock each level as you progress, with the freedom to replay anytime

Earn steam achievements 

Challenging end of level bosses

Stack-em up weapon system:  Collect as many weapons and fire them all at once!

Battle through 10 diverse levels—from deep space and mechanical worlds to Earth’s skies, underwater realms, sprawling cities, and beyond!

Enjoy 3–5 hours of action-packed gameplay, with even more hours to sink in through skill mastery and level replays

Hi-Score leaderboard with Time (hello speed-runs!)

Build up your Catnip power bar to unleash Feline Fury Special moves!

Awesome synth-wave retro cool soundtrack by Venice Bleach, with a dash of meow-ness layered in!

Did we also say - Surreal Bonkers end of level bosses?
